g.title: Circle, square, line
g.desc: Fundamental geometry, connected by radius, tangency, and a shared construction grid.

g.title: Anatomy of a letter
g.desc: A custom lowercase a exposes its circular bowl, counter, stem, and optical overshoot.

g.title: Over and under
g.desc: One warp and one weft reveal the alternating rule that holds a weave together.

g.title: A joint that holds
g.desc: A wider tail and narrower neck create one complementary boundary between two pieces.

g.title: The screen within the frame
g.desc: Shared corner centers and an eight-pixel offset construct the frame. Symmetric vertical and horizontal margins locate the safe area within it.

g.title: Common ground
g.desc: Two independent schedules share one precisely aligned window. The overlap becomes the composition’s central column.
